title: Upload invoice
sub: Upload a carrier invoice. Lines are read, matched to measurements and checked against the tariff.
returnHint: After the invoice is saved you return to the setup wizard, where the comparison result is listed.

toast.skipped: {{count}} rows were not added to the invoice; details are on the invoice page.
toast.pdfDisabledBody: PDF invoices are read with AI, which is currently off. Upload CSV or Excel.
toast.pdfQuota: This month's AI allowance is used up
toast.pdfQuotaBody: PDF invoices are read with AI, and this month's allowance is used up. Upload the invoice as CSV or Excel.
toast.aiOk: The read check found no issues.
toast.aiCheck: The read check has items to review.
toast.tooBigBody: You can upload up to {{mb}} MB.

gate.title: The mapping may have problems
gate.intro: The read check is not sure about this mapping. If you import anyway, affected lines are flagged as “Read check” on the invoice.
gate.extra: This mapping will be remembered for the carrier and used for later files too.
gate.check: I have seen the issues and want to import anyway
gate.pdfTitle: Some lines are in another currency
gate.pdfIntro: Some lines are not in the invoice currency. If you import anyway, these lines are flagged “Check” on the invoice.

save.title: This mapping looks problematic
save.intro: Save it anyway? A saved mapping is used automatically for this carrier's later files.
save.check: I have seen the issues and want to remember this mapping anyway

one.pickCarrierDesc: The column mapping suggestion and the comparison tariff are chosen based on this carrier.
one.noCarriers: No carrier has been added yet. Add a carrier first, and enter its tariff on the Tariffs screen for comparison.
one.noCarriersAsk: No carrier has been added yet. Ask your company admin to add the carrier.
one.uploadFileDesc: CSV, XLSX or PDF · up to {{mb}} MB. PDF invoices are read by AI and presented for your review.
one.uploadFileDescNoAi: CSV or XLSX · up to {{mb}} MB. PDF reading is off at the moment; upload the invoice as CSV or XLSX.
one.uploadFileDescQuota: CSV or XLSX · up to {{mb}} MB. This month's AI allowance is used up, so PDFs cannot be read; upload the invoice as CSV or XLSX.
one.readingPdf: The PDF is being read by AI. This may take a few seconds.
one.pdfQueued: The PDF is in line and will be read shortly.
one.pdfBackground: Reading continues even if you close the page. Choose the same file again to get the result right away.
one.needCarrier: Choose a carrier above to continue
one.aiOff: The PDF could not be read: AI reading is not available right now. Upload the CSV or XLSX version of the invoice.
one.sendFileSubject: Invoice file that could not be read
one.sendFileBody: Hello, the file {{name}} could not be read (error: {{code}}). I have attached the file to this email.
one.hint: Once a carrier and file are chosen, the file is read right away and you move on to column mapping.

meta.title: Invoice details
meta.desc: Values guessed from the file are filled in. Please review them.
meta.descPartial: Values found in the file are filled in. Enter the empty ones from the invoice.
meta.descNone: The invoice number and date were not found in the file. Enter them from the invoice.
meta.noMissing: No invoice number was found in the file. Enter the number shown on the invoice.
meta.dateMissing: No invoice date was found in the file. Select the date shown on the invoice.

wait.title: Comparison in progress.
wait.body: If the tariff and invoice currencies differ, daily exchange rates are fetched from the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (TCMB), which can take up to a minute. There is no need to reload. If you do, the import continues on the server and the invoice will appear in the Invoices list once processing finishes. Rates that could not be fetched in time are marked on the invoice and can be completed with “Recompare”.

meta.mappingSaved: Will be remembered for this carrier
meta.issues_one: {{n}} issue · confirmation will be required before import
meta.issues_other: {{n}} issues · confirmation will be required before import

err.unverified: The mapping may have problems. Review the issues and confirm, or fix the mapping.
err.exists: This invoice has already been uploaded. An invoice numbered {{no}} already exists for {{carrier}}. Check the invoice number or delete the old invoice.

wiz.pdfInvalid: Every line needs a tracking number and a net amount; weight and size cells must be valid numbers. A size needs all three edges above zero; if there is no size, leave all three empty.
wiz.trackingEmpty: The selected tracking number column is empty on every line. Choose a column that has data.
wiz.issues_one: The read check found {{n}} issue. You will be asked to confirm before import.
wiz.issues_other: The read check found {{n}} issues. You will be asked to confirm before import.
wiz.readyPdf: Lines are ready. Invoice details are next.
wiz.readyMapped: Required fields are mapped. Invoice details are next.
wiz.willImport: Lines are imported and checked against measurements and the tariff.

ai.wait: Columns are being mapped with AI. The headers and up to 12 sample rows are sent. This can take 10–30 seconds. The mapping is then checked on all lines.
ai.applied_one: AI mapping applied. {{n}} field was taken from AI; other verified choices were kept.
ai.applied_other: AI mapping applied. {{n}} fields were taken from AI; other verified choices were kept.
ai.dropped_one: {{n}} suggested header that is not in the file was discarded.
ai.dropped_other: {{n}} suggested headers that are not in the file were discarded.
ai.sourcesBelow: The source and check result of each field are shown below.
ai.unsure: Automatic mapping is not sure about this file.
ai.offError: AI mapping is not available right now. Map the columns manually.
ai.note: Headers are mapped whatever language they are in, and the result is checked on every line. Saved mappings and presets are applied automatically; AI is optional.

preview.title: File preview
preview.sub_one: first {{n}} line, mapped columns in blue
preview.sub_other: first {{n}} lines, mapped columns in blue

dateOrder.title: Choose the date order.
dateOrder.body: The dates in this file don't show their order. How should {{sample}} be read?

map.title: Column mapping
map.desc: For each DeciShip field, choose the column in the invoice. The first values of that column are shown on the right.
map.requiredHint: Required field: choose the column in the invoice.
map.savedApplied: Saved mapping applied. The mapping you last used for this carrier was filled in.
map.suggestedApplied: Suggested mapping filled in (confidence {{pct}}%). Review each field.
map.savedFallback: The saved mapping found no lines in this file, so the suggested mapping was used.

weightFormat.title: Choose how weights are written.
weightFormat.body: The weights in this file (like {{sample}}) can be read two ways. The choice applies only to the weights in this file; amounts do not change.

map.packagingHint: Pak / envelope info (e.g. "Service Packaging"), if any

sur.title: Surcharges and settings
sur.desc: Enter the column and code so surcharges defined in the tariff can be compared.

componentsVatSrc.default: Could not be detected from the file; assumed excl. tax. Change it if wrong.

sur.desiAsWeight: Use the “dimensional weight” column instead of billable weight (domestic)
sur.rememberLocked: This mapping is used for this invoice only. Only someone with settings access can change the carrier's saved mapping.

pdf.unverified: {{count}} rows could not be verified against the PDF text; they will be marked 'Review' after upload.
pdf.noTextLayer: This PDF is a scanned image; the values read could not be compared with the text.
pdf.cellUnverified: This value was not found in the PDF text; please check it.
pdf.aiSkipped: {{count}} charge rows were skipped because they have no tracking no. {{amount}}
pdf.currencyMixed_one: {{n}} line is not in the invoice currency ({{invoice}}): {{parts}}. Totals are shown per currency; you will be asked to confirm before import. Uploading these lines as a separate invoice is better.
pdf.currencyMixed_other: {{n}} lines are not in the invoice currency ({{invoice}}): {{parts}}. Totals are shown per currency; you will be asked to confirm before import. Uploading these lines as a separate invoice is better.
pdf.editHint: You can click cells to correct them, and add or delete lines. Net amounts exclude VAT; enter the amount excl. VAT when correcting.
pdf.cachedNote: This file was read before; the earlier reading is shown (free of charge).
pdf.emptyTitle: No lines could be read from the PDF
pdf.emptyBody: The file may be a scanned image. You can enter the lines manually or upload the CSV/XLSX version.
pdf.weightAmbiguous: Some weights are written like “{{sample}}” and can be read two ways. The choice applies to all of them:
pdf.cellWeightAmbiguous: This can be read two ways: choose above or write it differently (e.g. 1.5 or 1500).

reread.title: Read the PDF again?
reread.body: The file is read from scratch with AI, which counts toward this month's AI allowance. Corrections you made on this screen are discarded.

change.title: Read the file again?
change.body: Your selection changed, so the file is read from scratch. Corrections you made on this screen are discarded.

verifyFailed.text: The read check could not be completed. Retry before you continue.

resume.gone: This upload is no longer available. Choose the file again.
